name: Emerald Haze Regalia (Thúy Vi Tam Bảo)

bonuses.rule: the first time each fight you fall below a third of your health, haze (a Field) rises around you for 6 s. While it is up, you heal 3 % of your health each second, the foe gains 2 Wood stacks each second, and your Wood arts cost nothing while it lasts.

story: The three heirloom pieces split between the mountain seat and the lower seat: Ngu Lam Sơn holds the seal and the robe; Cù Thúy Bách keeps the founder's gourd on the ridge.

name: Field and Garden (Điền Viên Tam Kiện)

bonuses.rule: your heals over time also grant one Earth guard stack each second they tick, and while you hold 5 or more Earth guard stacks your health regeneration is doubled.

story: The Field Hall elder Quyền Thanh Lâm wears the seal and jacket; the Herb Garden keeper Khổng Đương Quy holds the gourd.

name: Evening Ferry (Vãn Độ)

bonuses.effect: Reach and Root (Cập Viễn Trát Căn)
bonuses.rule: a foe that cannot evade from a pole art of yours stays so 1 s longer for each 3 Wood stacks it carries, and that spends those stacks; each time the foe is made unable to evade this way again in a fight, the extra time is halved.

story: Hướng Vãn Chu's salt-marsh patrol pair: a cedar boat pole and a salt-crusted reed cape.

name: Far Ambition (Viễn Chí)

bonuses.effect: Everything at Once (Nhất Thời Tề Phát)
bonuses.rule: when you use a pill, your next needle art casts at once and puts double Wood stacks, and your heals are 20 % stronger for 3 s.

story: The pair forged for the foundling prodigy Kiển Viễn Chí.

name: Pine on the Cliff (Nhai Tùng)

bonuses.effect: The Pine That Does Not Move (Bất Động Tùng)
bonuses.rule: while in Pine Against the Wind, each hit you block puts a Wood stack on the attacker, and your next root-splitting art deals 10 % more for each Wood stack on its target, and spends those stacks.

story: Cù Thúy Bách's old-seat shield and stone-splitting axe, cut down from pine bark and ridge iron.

name: Green Fire (Thanh Hỏa Tam Kiện)

bonuses.rule: when a foe's Wood stacks from you run out, they rekindle once as Burn stacks of half their number.

story: Úy Thanh Diễm's Furnace Hall kit: the emerald censer, the pulse needle, and the scorch-hemmed robe.

name: Cold Ford Watch (Hàn Tân Canh)

bonuses.effect: No Hiding on the Quay (Ngạn Vô Ẩn)
bonuses.rule: a foe that cannot evade loses its concealment, and each second it cannot evade your next Wood art against it deals 8 % more; that art spends the bonus, and it is lost when it can evade again.

story: Hướng Dạ Đăng's border watch kit at Hàn Tân Thành: the quay lamp, the river spear, and the frost-proof quay coat.

name: The Salt Chest (Diêm Rương Tam Kiện)

bonuses.effect: What the Chest Kept (Rương Trung Vật)
bonuses.rule: once a fight, when your linh lực falls below a quarter, the lock opens: you regain half your linh lực and gain a haze ward worth 10 % of your health.

story: Diêm Hải Tạo's port-house kit at Yên Ba Thành: the salt-chest pendant lock, the cove fan, and the crusted coat.

name: Poria Under Pine (Tùng Hạ Phục Linh)

bonuses.rule: once a fight, a heal that lands on you while you are below a quarter of your health also gives you a Wood ward worth 10 % of your health.

story: Thiệu Thanh Đài's healer regalia: the green moss mirror, the poria medicine gourd, and the weeping-willow robe.

name: Cliff Hall Champion (Nhai Đường Tam Kiện)

bonuses.effect: Lean Until It Breaks (Ỷ Chí Đoạn)
bonuses.rule: each hit on a foe whose guard you cracked adds a Wood stack and 3 % pierce against it, and every tenth such hit breaks the foe's block for 3 s; the pierce falls by 3 % each second you do not hit that foe.

story: Hoàn Cô Bách's heavy vanguard set from the Cliff Hall.
